evidence: Trimethylaluminum (TMA, Al(CH3)3) is one of the most commonly used metal-organic sources in various industries. It is an important precursor for the preparation of III -V compound semiconductors. More recently, TMA has been the main metal precursor for atomic layer deposition (ALD) of high dielectric gate oxide Al2O3 in real device integration. O3 is currently under investigation as an alternative oxygen precursor for ALD applications.
